figures.caption: 圖一：在家自學的上午
figures.description: 上午十點，明亮的客廳裡，一名高中女生坐在餐桌前，左手邊攤開一本數學課本，右手拿著觸控筆在平板上作答，平板螢幕上寫著「單元 3」「進度 80%」。她的母親坐在她旁邊，手上拿著一本筆記本，準備隨時幫忙。牆上貼著一張她和家人一起排的每週課表，桌上放著一杯水，窗外看得到一棵樹。整個客廳只有她們兩人，十分安靜。

questions.stem: 提示：有些家庭選擇讓孩子在家自學，由家長安排課程，讓孩子依自己的進度學習；大多數學生則每天到學校和同學一起上課。請仔細觀察下面兩張圖，寫一篇英文作文，文分兩段。第一段比較圖一在家自學與圖二到校上課兩種學習方式的不同；第二段評估這兩種學習方式對學生的學習與成長各有什麼利弊，並提出一個能讓學生兼得兩者優點的具體做法。

1.explanation_zh: 這一題有三個要求：第一段比較兩種學習方式；第二段評估兩者對學習與成長的利弊，再提出兼得兩者優點的做法。比較點可以從圖中找：學習進度（平板顯示進度 80%、自己排的課表）、學習對象（母親一對一陪伴、同學分組討論）、環境（安靜的客廳、熱鬧的操場）。第二段要兩邊都寫利與弊，而且「學習」與「成長」（交朋友、合作）都要談到；做法要真的兼顧兩邊，只寫「在家自學比較好」或「上學比較好」都只回應了一半。
evidence: 比較圖一在家自學與圖二到校上課兩種學習方式的不同
評估這兩種學習方式對學生的學習與成長各有什麼利弊
提出一個能讓學生兼得兩者優點的具體做法
1.strategy_zh: 用自己跟不上進度、或在團體中學到東西的經驗，說明兩種方式各自的好處；方案可以從「時間怎麼分配」著手（例如幾天自學、幾天團體活動），讓做法直接回應兩邊的利弊。
hints: 第一段：從進度、學習對象、環境三點對照兩張圖
第二段前半：兩種方式各寫好處與限制，學習與成長都要談到
第二段後半：提出兼顧兩邊的安排，說明怎麼做，最後寫出見解

moves.zh: 比較圖一在家自學與圖二到校上課兩種學習方式的不同
評估這兩種學習方式對學生的學習與成長各有什麼利弊
提出一個能讓學生兼得兩者優點的具體做法

content.focus_zh: 第一段要用圖中細節逐點比較兩種學習方式（學習進度由誰決定、和誰一起學、環境安靜或熱鬧）；第二段要同時評估兩種方式對學習與成長的利弊，並提出一個兼得兩者優點的具體做法。

bands.descriptor_zh: 回應題目的每一項要求，主旨明確；用具體的事例、細節或親身經驗撐起每個重點。
大致回應題目，但有一項要求寫得單薄，或細節偏籠統、說服力不足。
漏掉題目的主要要求或主旨模糊，多數句子空泛、重複或偏離題目。
空白、離題、只抄題目，或內容少到無法判斷要說什麼。

organization.focus_zh: 第一段以對照方式比較兩張圖，最後歸納兩種方式的根本差異；第二段先評估利弊，再用經驗或讓步帶出折衷的方案，結尾提出見解。

bands.descriptor_zh: 兩段分工清楚，各有主題句；句與句、段與段的銜接自然，轉承語用得恰當，篇幅分配合理。
段落大致分明，但有的地方跳接或重複，轉承語偏少或用得生硬。
重點排列混亂，前後句常接不起來，讀者不容易跟上。
看不出段落與順序，句子彼此無關。

grammar.focus_zh: 描述圖片用現在進行式或現在式；比較用 whereas、while、by contrast；評估可用 allow／let＋受詞＋動詞，方案可用 could、would。

bands.descriptor_zh: 句子幾乎沒有文法、標點錯誤，能交替使用簡單句、複句與不同的句首。
偶有時態、單複數或標點錯誤，但讀得懂意思；句型變化有限。
錯誤多到常讓人誤解意思，句子結構常不完整。
幾乎沒有正確的句子，無法理解。

vocabulary.focus_zh: 學習相關字詞要精確（at one's own pace、homeschooling、group discussion、PE class、self-paced），避免一直重複 learn、study、good。

bands.descriptor_zh: 用字精準、貼切，搭配自然，少有重複；拼字與大小寫幾乎全對。
字彙範圍偏窄、常重複同幾個字，偶有用字不當或拼錯，但不妨礙理解。
用錯字或拼錯字很多，常讓人看不懂。
幾乎每個字都用錯或拼錯，無法理解。

rubric.deductions_zh: 字數明顯不足（少於 100 個單詞）或沒有分成兩段，各扣總分 1 分；兩種情形同時發生只扣 1 分。離題或空白以 0 分計。

model_texts.label: steady
model_texts.text:
The two pictures show two different ways of learning. In Picture 1, a girl is studying math at home at her own pace. She is working on a tablet with her textbook open beside her, and her mother is sitting next to her. The living room is quiet, and there are no other students around. In Picture 2, on the other hand, students are learning at school. In the classroom, four students are discussing a big poster in a group while their teacher listens. On the playground, other students are racing on the track in a PE class as two classmates cheer for them.
Both ways of learning have advantages and disadvantages. Studying at home lets students learn at their own speed, so they do not need to wait for others or hurry to catch up. However, they may feel lonely and miss the chance to make friends. Going to school is more fun because we can work in groups and play sports together. But in a big class, a teacher cannot always help every student. Last year, I fell behind in math, and I was too shy to ask questions in class. I think the best way is to combine the two. For example, schools can let students watch math videos at home first and then use class time for group discussion and questions. In this way, students can learn at their own pace and still enjoy school life.

model_texts.label: top
model_texts.text:
The two pictures present sharply different ideas of what a school day can look like. In Picture 1, a teenage girl is working through a math unit on a tablet at the dining table, with her textbook open beside her and her mother sitting close by, ready to help. A weekly timetable that she planned with her family hangs on the wall, and the screen shows that she has completed 80% of Unit 3, suggesting that she moves on only when she is ready. Picture 2, by contrast, is full of voices and movement. In the classroom, four students have pushed their desks together to discuss a large poster while their teacher listens, and on the playground, students in a PE class race around the track as their classmates cheer them on. Whereas homeschooling is built around a single learner's needs, school life is built around a group.
Each approach has clear strengths, but each also leaves something out. Learning at home gives students the autonomy to slow down on difficult topics and move quickly through easy ones, which can make study far more efficient. When I struggled with functions last year, I wished I could replay the lesson as many times as I needed instead of pretending to understand so that I would not hold up the class. Yet a classroom of one cannot easily offer what the second picture shows: debating ideas with peers, losing a race, and learning to cooperate with people we did not choose. These experiences build social skills that matter long after graduation, and a society depends on citizens who can disagree respectfully and still pursue collective goals. Admittedly, schools cannot give every student individual attention, and some homeschooled children join sports teams or clubs to meet friends. Still, I believe the most practical solution is to blend the two models rather than choose between them. Schools could, for instance, set aside two mornings a week for self-paced study. During these sessions, students would work through online units at their own speed, with teachers serving as tutors, and the rest of the week would be kept for group projects, labs, and sports. Such a schedule would combine the flexibility of learning at home with the sense of community at school. In the end, a good education should respect each student's pace without forgetting how much we learn from one another.

paragraphs.function_zh: 比較兩張圖：用平板進度、自己排的課表說明圖一依個人步調學習，再對照圖二的分組討論與體育課，最後歸納「以個人為中心」與「以團體為中心」的差異

top.comment_zh: 第一段以對照方式逐點比較：圖一女孩在餐桌用平板寫數學、母親在旁、課表是和家人一起排的、進度 80% 顯示自訂進度；圖二分組討論海報、老師旁聽、體育課賽跑與加油，最後用 Whereas 歸納「以個人需求為中心 vs. 以群體為中心」。第二段先評估在家自學的自主與效率（以學函數時怕拖累全班的經驗佐證），再指出缺少同儕辯論、輸掉比賽、與人合作的社交成長，用 Admittedly 讓步後提出每週兩個上午自主進度學習、其餘時間做專題與運動的混合方案，結尾有見解。句構與用字都很成熟（autonomy、hold up the class、blend the two models、self-paced）。未見錯誤；篇幅偏長、第二段比重大，但不影響分數。

steady.comment_zh: 三項要求都有回應：第一段用圖中細節比較兩種方式（平板與課本、母親在旁、客廳安靜沒有同學 vs. 分組討論、體育課賽跑與加油）；第二段分別說明自學可依自己的速度、但可能寂寞交不到朋友，到校較有趣、但大班老師顧不到每個人，以數學落後又不敢發問的經驗佐證，再提出先在家看影片、上課討論的做法。缺點是第一段沒有歸納兩者的根本差異，評估各只有一句、論證偏淺；主詞在 students／they 與 we 之間轉換；learn、learning、students 重複多。未見文法、用字或標點錯誤。

top.comment_zh: 第一段用平板「進度 80%」、每週課表、四人討論、體育課賽跑等圖中細節逐點對照，並以 whereas 句歸納根本差異；第二段兼顧兩種方式的利弊與讓步，提出每週兩個上午自學的混合課表。句型與用字出色，未發現語言錯誤。

steady.comment_zh: 第一段多為分別描述兩張圖，缺少明確的並列比較句；第二段利弊與親身經驗清楚，並提出先在家看影片、課堂再討論的具體做法。結構完整，句型與用字平實，learn/learning 重複；未發現語言錯誤。
